snippet.title: The Beatles - In My Life - 2026 Mix (Visualiser)
snippet.description:
‘In My Life’ is from the Beatles' sixth album, Rubber Soul, originally released on December 3rd, 1965. The audio is sourced directly from the original four-track master tapes and newly mixed by producer Giles Martin and Sam Okell.  


Listen to Rubber Soul – Special Editions https://TheBeatles.lnk.to/RubberSoulID 


Lyrics 

There are places I remember 
All my life, though some have changed 
Some forever, not for better 
Some have gone and some remain 

All these places had their moments 
With lovers and friends I still can recall 
Some are dead and some are living 
In my life I've loved them all 

But of all these friends and lovers 
There’s no one compares with you 
And these memories lose their meaning 
When I think of love as something new 

Though I know I'll never lose affection 
For people and things that went before 
I know I often stop and think about them 
In my life I love you more 

Tho' I know I'll never lose affection 
For people and things that went before 
I know I'll often stop and think about them 
In my life I love you more 

In my life I love you more

I’m forced to mark my territory X2

snippet.title: THE SKY BELOW | CONTROL Resonant Song feat. Cami-Cat
snippet.description:
CONTROL Resonant is available now for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC on Steam and the Epic Games Store! https://yrstru.ly/Stupes-Resonant

Well, you probably guessed this was coming. I am a HUGE fan of Remedy games, and after we made ‘Slide into the Void’ six years ago for Control, we HAD to do a follow-up for Control Resonant! Luckily the wonderful folks over at Remedy Games wanted to sponsor us again after our Alan Wake project ‘The Ribbon’, and here we are!
I’m very grateful, because their sponsorship meant we could go ALL OUT on this video. We have ALL the toys in this one: Armando our robot arm, a new (second-hand) super slow-mo camera, the smoke machine, the caustic light projector, prismatic lens filters, an air-compressor… and that’s just the gear! Did I mention we booked a rain studio and custom built TWO sets? AND ONE ROTATES? 
Yeah, the whole team worked super hard on this one. Every second is packed full of really cool stuff, I think it came out incredibly. I hope you think so too! Maybe take a second to look at all the lovely names in the credits below and appreciate them for their work!
Special thanks to the wonderful @Cami-Cat for jumping on this track and providing the vocals for Jesse’s character. We had to get her back on this one as she’s been on all of my other Remedy-verse songs! She knocks it out of the park every single time - go give her some love!

#ad #remedygames #controlresonant

localized.title: THE SKY BELOW | CONTROL Resonant Song feat. Cami-Cat
localized.description:
CONTROL Resonant is available now for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC on Steam and the Epic Games Store! https://yrstru.ly/Stupes-Resonant

Well, you probably guessed this was coming. I am a HUGE fan of Remedy games, and after we made ‘Slide into the Void’ six years ago for Control, we HAD to do a follow-up for Control Resonant! Luckily the wonderful folks over at Remedy Games wanted to sponsor us again after our Alan Wake project ‘The Ribbon’, and here we are!
I’m very grateful, because their sponsorship meant we could go ALL OUT on this video. We have ALL the toys in this one: Armando our robot arm, a new (second-hand) super slow-mo camera, the smoke machine, the caustic light projector, prismatic lens filters, an air-compressor… and that’s just the gear! Did I mention we booked a rain studio and custom built TWO sets? AND ONE ROTATES? 
Yeah, the whole team worked super hard on this one. Every second is packed full of really cool stuff, I think it came out incredibly. I hope you think so too! Maybe take a second to look at all the lovely names in the credits below and appreciate them for their work!
Special thanks to the wonderful @Cami-Cat for jumping on this track and providing the vocals for Jesse’s character. We had to get her back on this one as she’s been on all of my other Remedy-verse songs! She knocks it out of the park every single time - go give her some love!

LYRICS:

I don't want the pain,
I want to be okay.
But I can feel my mind,
Slip away from time.
But I won't crash,
Or brace.
Go faster I don’t race to lose.
I can't lose, I can't lose.

I drift away sometimes, (sometimes)
Fear what I feel inside again.
And when the fearing's interfering,
I'm persevering through the feeling.
And revealing a way that I can get up,
Get up, get up.

This is our race to win.
This is our race to win.

Driven mad to the brim,
Call the Reaper, things look grim,
I’m drifting out, drifting in,
Drifting deeper into sin.
Start again, start again.

snippet.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer Review
snippet.description:
Star Wars: Galactic Racer reviewed by Luke Reilly on Xbox Series X. Also available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series S, and PC.

"Star Wars: Galactic Racer is a fabulous looking and frantically fast anti-grav racer that impressively goes further than just taking the decades-old Star Wars Racer games and giving them a 4K facelift. With a range of satisfyingly customisable vehicle classes beyond podracers, a world outside the racing you can soak in and explore in third-person, and an interesting roguelite-adjacent structure that injects a considerable degree of risk into the action, Galactic Racer is a fresh and accomplished blend of Lucas lore with the destructive spirit of arcade racing icons like Burnout and MotorStorm. Its run-based campaign can grow unavoidably tedious over long stints because of its heavy reliance on repeatedly revisiting the same slim selection of planets, and its lack of splitscreen is disappointing considering its roots run back to consoles regarded as the kings of same-couch chaos. But Galactic Racer is an otherwise confident debut from developer Fuse Games, and one that has successfully lit the afterburners on a long-dormant slice of the Star Wars universe."

snippet.title: Don't Miss The Best Start in Witcher 3 Remastered Tips!
snippet.description:
Get the best start in the Witcher 3 Remastered!
👉 Secrets You Missed in White Orchard: https://youtu.be/vCpIpAGO708?si=QqwSEWysrUNxAg2B
👉 All Witcher 3 Guides: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLl_Xou7GtCi4RvGKiVFptdQ7cmBMjRlTI
👉 Get The Best Armor in The Game: https://youtu.be/C2BxSrRwDj0?si=KfNQYmq-UwKIG--r
👉 Moonblade Location: https://youtu.be/wcWj7Wb3z0Q?si=s-HRzIa-hvYMaK1v

Want to get the best gear in The Witcher 3 Remastered? This guide shows you where to get the best early-game silver sword and steel sword locations, including their crafting materials and upgrades. And where to find the best armor set as you level up. I'll explain how to get the armor of Thousand Flowers, Nine-Tailed Swords, White Tiger of the West and new Scarlet Crest armor sets, plus some important missable collectibles and the best sword in the game. If you're starting a new playthrough of The Witcher 3 Remastered, this guide will help you get some of the strongest gear available as early as possible, weather your a beginner or returning player.


➖ Side Quests Checklist for White Orchard ➖
• A Frying Pan, Spick and Span: Investigate the burnt hut near the sawmill, find the frying pan inside, and return it to the old woman.
• Faithful Friend: Find the dead horse near the battlefield and locate its owner.
• Missing in Action: Speak to Dune at the mill, follow his dog's trail across the battlefield, and look for his brother Bastian.
• On Death's Bed: Visit Tomira at the herbalist hut and brew buckthorn to cure the poisoned local girl.
• Precious Cargo: Help the merchant trapped near the river reclaim his stolen medicine box from a ghoul-infested area, choosing whether to turn him in or let him go.
• Twisted Firestarter: Inspect the burnt-down forge behind the blacksmith, track the arsonist's footprints to the river, and confront him.
• The other quests can all be done later if you return to White Orchard.

snippet.title: VALORANT Champions Shanghai — Group Stage — Day 8
snippet.description:
Every era eventually meets its challenger. In 2026, VCT saw the beginning of that shift. New contenders have emerged, expectations have been broken, and twice at Masters, a new champion has risen. Now it all comes together in Shanghai, a city where history and the future live side by side. From September 24 to October 18, familiar names, new contenders, and a fearless generation of challengers will compete for the biggest trophy of the year.

Sixteen teams from Americas, CN, EMEA, and Pacific will battle to become the 2026 VALORANT World Champion.

We’re proud to work with our fantastic partners throughout 2026: AWS, Coinbase, EWC, ENC, Globant, HyperX, Mastercard, OnePlus, Red Bull, Secretlab, and Verizon.
